title: OtoLogic standard SFX selection
description: Twelve standard OtoLogic effects the owner kept in the 2026-08-23 SFX listen-through. (Count: 12)
when_to_use: A tense rising sweep (warning siren 04) / a whoosh for a fast cut (swing 06) / a success sparkle (bell accent 14) / two pop clicks (onomatopoeia pop 04, PC mouse 01) / a low woody tap for a caption (percussion accent 04) / a bright soft click (PC mouse 04) / a light tap (castanet 02) / a single wood block (wood block 01) / a sparkle emphasis (bell accent 16) / a quiet sparkle (bell accent 10) / a xylophone glissando for a scene change (xylophone 06)
